implementation_scope: Implement, validate, commit, and execute the complete 240-job PACK-RESTORE PPO-capacity by adaptation-time teacher-guidance main experiment without time-based or interim-result pruning.

execution_authorization.understood_as: After M and L pass real 512-by-64 Dual one-update GPU smoke tests, the expected_config regression is fixed, provenance is recorded, storage is checked, and the execution code plus manifest are committed, launch all 240 jobs without time-based or interim-result pruning.

parent_architecture.role: source of the unchanged CNN, shared layer, two actor layers, and four critic layers

path_base: repository root at the committed execution_code_sha recorded in run_manifest.json
questions: Does increasing GC-PPO actor-critic capacity produce PACK-RESTORE exploitation?
Does adaptation-time teacher imitation remain useful for larger policies?
Do differences appear in final level, experience-to-exploitation, or retention stability?

teacher.architecture: unchanged Dual LEO teacher with input BatchRenorm
teacher.training: learned separately from each Dual policy's visited data

per_size_and_seed: one G pretraining job followed by fixed and mutant G adaptation
one full-Dual pretraining job loaded independently by fixed and mutant D-on adaptation
the same full-Dual checkpoint loaded independently by fixed and mutant D-off adaptation
run_graph.dependency_rule: No adaptation job is eligible until its own pretraining checkpoint at update 512 is complete.

D-on_and_D-off_share_before_adaptation: global update, environment-step, and rollout-cursor counters
branch_identity.only_adaptation_arm_difference: D-off still computes the teacher forward pass and BC loss but multiplies the policy BC term by zero. Teacher learning and RNG-consuming operations remain enabled.
branch_identity.post_start_divergence: Once the policy updates differ, later on-policy visits and therefore learned teacher states may also differ; only the adaptation start is required to be identical.
branch_identity.G_vs_D-on_interpretation: whole learning method from pretraining onward

seed_note: Ten seeds are an operational response to prior seed variance, not a power guarantee.

schedule.adaptation_update_0: the loaded pretraining state after switching the commanded goal, before any adaptation optimizer update
schedule.job_order: seed-major; S, M, and L are interleaved within each seed bundle

optimization.teacher_input_normalization: BatchRenorm with its existing running-state contract
optimization.teacher_learning_rate_schedule: linear to 1e-20 over 4608 updates times 64 minibatches times 2 epochs

checkpoint_storage.retention: Retain every science-evaluation JSON and the final state of every job. During a running job retain one rolling resumable state; remove its predecessor only after the successor state and any science curve at that update are written.
checkpoint_storage.margin_scope: The margin covers one serialized worker's temporary predecessor-plus-successor overlap and non-checkpoint artifacts; the queue must run with concurrency 1.

evaluation.sample_definition: four stochastic repeats per validation state
evaluation.cross_evaluation: Every science-evaluation adaptation checkpoint is evaluated under fixed and mutant kernels.
D_discovery_and_use: first science checkpoint with nonzero use
retention or disappearance at later checkpoints
evaluation.violation_delivery_rate: fraction of evaluation episodes that deliver grain attributed to a conservation-violating creation event
evaluation.V_realized_gain: For the same mutant-adapted policy, mutant-kernel minus fixed-kernel success rate, return, and length; interpret the sign of length together with success and return.
evaluation.primary_metric: Within the same size, condition, seed, checkpoint, policy view, and start family: U = mutant-kernel violation_delivery_rate of the mutant-adapted policy minus that of the fixed-continued policy.

report: 20,000-resample learner-seed bootstrap 95% percentile intervals for means
statistics.learning_failures: retain every completed seed regardless of performance
statistics.technical_failures: do not impute missing or corrupt jobs; resume from declared checkpoints and keep the aggregate status incomplete until all expected artifacts pass validation

preregistered_extension.question: Does the post-guidance difference persist, or do delayed learners catch up?

implementation.execution_command: From the repository root: HACKRL_DEVICE=cuda bash scripts/run_pack_restore_scale_bc_queue.sh
implementation.job_failure_behavior: A technical exception stops the single worker without marking the job complete. Relaunch the same command after resolving the cause; the queue resumes from the newest retained state and never removes a seed or condition.
implementation.code_lock: Queue startup refuses uncommitted changes in execution sources and writes the exact Git SHA, manifest SHA-256, and execution-source SHA-256 values to run_manifest.json.
implementation.checkpoint_provenance: Every final pretraining checkpoint has a SHA-256 content fingerprint over state.msgpack, config.json, metadata.json, and arm.json when present. The combined digest hashes sorted file names, a NUL separator, each lowercase file digest, and a newline. Every adaptation cell records that origin; aggregation rehashes each retained source and requires the four D-on/D-off fixed/mutant branches for each size and seed to share one fingerprint.
implementation.queue_preparation_note: Authorized for full execution after all launch gates pass.

validation_evidence.real_update_shape: 512 environments by 64 steps, full Dual update

interpretation_limit: This experiment supports claims about the encoded PACK-RESTORE mechanism and tested optimization contract, not general real-world exploit discovery.
launch_gates: all initialized parameter counts match this manifest
D-on and D-off resolve to the same full-Dual pretraining checkpoint
BC-off keeps teacher learning and teacher-shuffle RNG consumption
legacy PACK-RESTORE checkpoints still deserialize as policy width 512 and teacher width 512
focused tests and real 512-by-64 Dual one-update GPU smoke runs for S, M, and L pass
the scheduled-checkpoint expected_config regression test passes
execution sources and this manifest are committed before queue startup
measured final-state retention plus an 8 GiB margin fits available storage
